===The Dark Squall===
[[File:While Guthix Sleeps - Black Knight Catacombs map.png|thumb|200px|A map of the Black Knight Catacombs.]]
{{Needed|9 free inventory spaces, combat equipment for two attack styles as well as [[standard magic]] (powered staves don't work), a [[bronze med helm]] and [[iron chainbody]] (or a [[black armour set]]), an [[unpowered orb]], runes to cast a [[charge orb]] spell. For the boss fight, you'll need runes for the following spells: multiple casts of all four elemental spells, [[Snare]]/[[Entangle]], [[Weaken]]/[[Enfeeble]], [[Telekinetic Grab]], and [[Low Level Alchemy|Low]]/[[High Level Alchemy]]; as such, you will need Air, Water, Earth, Fire, Body/Soul, Nature, Law, Cosmic and your choice of [[catalytic runes]]).|recommended=Emergency teleport for anyone under 100 combat, Stamina Potion, and some food}}
[[File:While Guthix Sleeps - inner base labels.png|thumb|400px|Objects to search for within the Dark Squall's inner base, once the player is properly disguised.]]
{{Checklist|
* Return to [[Akrisae]] at the [[White Knights' Castle]] in Falador. Watch the ensuing cutscene with [[Hazelmere]], then finish the conversation with Akrisae and accept his offer to teleport you to [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]]. If you didn't accept the teleport, [[Mind altar teleport (tablet)|Mind Altar Teleport]], [[combat bracelet]] teleport to the [[Edgeville Monastery]], and [[Lassar teleport (tablet)|Lassar Teleport]] are the fastest ways to get there.
* Equip the disguise you brought ([[bronze med helm]] and [[iron chainbody]] or a [[black armour set]]) to enter the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]].
* Push the hidden wall directly ahead and climb down the ladder.
* Head south towards the tiled flooring, and inspect the carved tile with an orb symbol on it.
* Cast any charged orb spell on the carved tile, and enter the trapdoor to access the [[Black Knight Catacombs]].
* Head immediately north to the western, broken bridge whilst praying [[Protect from Missiles]], then jump across it.
* Pray [[Protect from Melee]] and kill the [[Elite Black Knight]] that is accompanied by [[Elite Dark Warrior]]s until you have a full set of [[elite black armour]].
* Wear the armour, then run to the north-east path and climb up the wall to the second level.
* Head north and around the barricades, then run north-west until you reach two solid doors. Use the western door to unlock a shortcut back to the Black Knight Catacombs' exit.
* Enter the northern door to the Dark Squall's inner base.
* Search the wardrobe north of the entrance for a second set of elite black armour to give to [[Silif]].
* Search the wardrobe to the south of the room for the [[Dark Squall's robes]].
* Search the table with the lobster and restore potion to obtain the two items. If you have an additional three inventory spaces, take the [[strange teleorb]] alongside the [[Death rune|death]] and [[law rune]]; otherwise, you can take them later.
* Search the key rack in the north wall for a [[cell key]].
* Head back and use the long, eastern path and attempt to open the gate to Silif's cell.
* Use the lobster (any food works) and restore potion on Silif.
* Talk to Silif until you give him the elite black armour. You can equip the Dark Squall's robes now if needed and simply give Silif your set.
* With Silif following you, head back to the Dark Squall's inner base.
* Go to the Map board to the south, few steps east of the entrance and Silif will notice the map boards on the wall. Finish the conversation for a teleorb.
* With the Dark Squall's robes equipped, climb up the ladder at the eastern side of the room. Be prepared for a boss fight. (You can prepare and re-enter the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]] by wearing the Dark Squall's robes and also prevent enemy aggression).
* Defeat [[Surok Magis|Surok]] with Magic (He '''CANNOT BE FOUGHT''' with other styles). He has 450 Hitpoints and is immune to powered staves, so you cannot use weapons such as the [[trident of the seas]] and [[warped sceptre]]. Pray [[Protect from Magic]] to reduce damage taken. He still does chip damage, so take some food. 10-15 karambwans and 1 prayer pot is enough. Surok follows the same attack pattern as [[Vorkath]], performing 6 regular attacks before using one of the special attacks below for every 7th attack.
** Henchmen: Surok will call in either a [[Strong Warrior]] or [[Agile Warrior]] to approach and bind you. The Agile Warrior must be bound via [[Bind]] and the Strong Warrior must be weakened via [[Weaken]]. Kill the warrior after using the proper counter spell. Stronger versions of each respective counter spell will also work. If the warrior reaches you, Surok will launch a spell that deals 40+ damage.
** Explosive: Surok will throw an explosive orb around the player. This must be telegrabbed and then alched, or it will explode and deal 45+ damage. Picking it up will cause it to immediately explode.
** Surge attack: Surok will cast 1-4 elemental surges at the player. To nullify these attacks, the player must cast a spell of the opposite element on the incoming attack (i.e. air for earth, water for fire, earth for air, and fire for water). Otherwise, they will deal significant damage (45+).
* Once defeated, plant the orb on Surok. 
* Finish the conversation and return to Akrisae at White Knights' Castle.
* Wear the Dark Squall's robes and enter the jail cell.
* If you didn't do so earlier, take the [[strange teleorb]] alongside the [[Death rune|death]] and [[law rune]] from the desks downstairs.
* Run to the middle of the room and activate the strange teleorb whilst standing within the magic circle to teleport to [[Lucien's camp]].
* Run along the north-east path until you are across the [[Chaos Temple (hut)|Chaos Temple]], then climb up the ice wall and jump to the ledge. This '''will not''' take you into the Wilderness, and your items are '''safe'''.
* Walk towards the eastern side of the Chaos Temple's roof to view the cutscene.
* After the cutscene, return to White Knights' Castle.
}}
